script.title: जन्म लेते ही 'राम' बोलने वाले बालक रामबोला की कथा
sentences: कथा है, जन्म लेते ही यह बालक रोया नहीं, 'राम' बोला!
मान्यता है कि जन्म के समय उसके मुँह में पूरे बत्तीस दाँत थे।
इसीलिए उसका नाम रखा गया रामबोला, यानी जो राम बोले।
पर चौथी रात ही माता-पिता ने उसे घर की सेविका चुनिया के साथ भेज दिया।
साढ़े पाँच साल बाद चुनिया चल बसीं, और वह अनाथ बालक काम और भिक्षा के लिए दर-दर भटकने लगा।
बाद में उसे वैरागी दीक्षा और एक नया नाम मिला।
वही रामबोला आगे चलकर बने गोस्वामी तुलसीदास जी, जिन्होंने हनुमान चालीसा और रामचरितमानस की रचना की!
क्या आप जानते थे कि तुलसीदास जी का बचपन का नाम रामबोला था?
scenes: Extreme close-up of a newborn baby's peaceful face in 16th-century north India, eyes wide open and lips forming a word instead of crying, soft divine golden glow, mother's hands wrapped in a sari around him.
Stunned family elders in a 16th-century north Indian village home leaning over a newborn wrapped in cloth, faces full of astonishment and fear, oil lamp light, medium shot.
A village priest in a dhoti and tilak holding the newborn Rambola, announcing his name with a joyful expression, family gathered around in a mud-walled courtyard, morning light, medium shot.
At night the servant woman Chuniya in a plain cotton sari carrying the baby Rambola away from a village house, looking back sadly, a single lantern lighting the path, moonlit wide shot.
A thin orphan boy Rambola, about six, in torn clothes, holding out a small bowl at village doorways, lonely hopeful eyes, dusty lane, harsh afternoon light, medium shot.
A saffron-robed guru placing a hand of blessing on the head of the young Rambola beside a river, the boy's face calm and transformed, soft sunrise light, medium shot.

Goswami Tulsidas as an elderly saint with a tilak and white beard writing on palm-leaf manuscripts beside the Ganga in Varanasi, a gentle image of Hanuman and Rama glowing in the background mist, devotional golden light.
Goswami Tulsidas smiling serenely, seated on a ghat at Varanasi with a manuscript in his lap, the river glowing at sunset, medium close-up.
script.description:
जन्म लेते ही 'राम' बोलने वाला अनाथ बालक रामबोला।
जो आगे चलकर बने गोस्वामी तुलसीदास।
claims_en: Legend goes that Tulsidas did not cry at birth but uttered Rama instead.
Legend says he had all thirty-two teeth in his mouth at birth.
He was therefore named Rambola (he who uttered Rama).
On the fourth night he was sent away by his parents with Chuniya, a female house-help.
Chuniya looked after him for five and a half years and then died; he became an orphan wandering door to door for menial jobs and alms.
He was given the Virakta (Vairagi) initiation with the new name Tulsidas.
Tulsidas is the author of the Hanuman Chalisa and the Ramcharitmanas.
